scope: 第1目标转场，第2目标动态避障，按用户确认分开分析

onsite.result: 动态避障未成功，机器人直接停车

confirmed_findings.evidence: All 1795 goal2 dynamic_points messages had zero points; motion_qualified_track_count always 0. Residuals 93–228, clusters 2–11 and confirmed tracks 2–10 existed; health true.
confirmed_findings.boundary: No per-track rejection-reason telemetry. Cannot identify the exact failing motion predicate or claim no LiDAR returns.

confirmed_findings.issue: Moving repair waits until activation, then requires future activation lead
confirmed_findings.evidence: planner_manager.cpp:551–555 sleeps until trajectory_start_time for successful have_local_traj; remani_replan_fsm.cpp:3392–3400 rejects moving repair when remaining lead <20ms. Three measured repairs ~709.8/700.9/740.9ms rejected late.
confirmed_findings.boundary: Some measured wall time can be intentional wait, not all compute. Runtime provenance/code audit is separately saved.

confirmed_findings.issue: Slow and fast layers used different trajectory phase and feedback ages
confirmed_findings.evidence: At dynamic stop, slow phase7.62484 equals wall-clock elapsed; controller phase6.27817, latest fast phase6.24245. Slow odom cached age818ms; fast before-delivery base82.6ms/joints18.6ms/map243.7ms fresh.
confirmed_findings.boundary: Exact failed internal progress freshness/match condition not directly recorded. Shared synchronous callbacks and >500ms calls support callback staleness mechanism.

confirmed_findings.issue: Fast navigation stopped after native reference cancellation
confirmed_findings.evidence: Approach interval had27 delivered nominal commands and no MPPI deadline rejection; native abort followed by ~32.95s zero commands. Final failed recovery discarded goal and entered WAIT_TARGET.
confirmed_findings.boundary: Delivered nominal commands do not prove a successful dynamic bypass or infeasibility of all alternatives.

data_coverage.geometry_stop: 128MiB configured bound; covers all three second-goal aborts
